attributes.name: Boar Demon
attributes.powers:
The Boar Demon may not be evaded and is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits.

Before you act, succeed at a Wisdom or Knowledge 12 check or your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma skills are each 1d4 until the end of the encounter. Choose another character at your location; that character summons and encounters this adventure's servitor demon.
